name: SSHI_Bridge_PiFilter
rationale: The previous 'SSHI_Bridge_Clamp' design was very close, but failed on startup time (tup) for light/weak loads. Reducing C_out to speed up startup increases the voltage ripple (vpp), creating a trade-off. To break this, I am implementing a pi-filter (C-L-C) after the rectifier. C_in absorbs the high-current charge pulses from the SSHI bridge, while L_filt and C_out form a low-pass filter that provides a very smooth DC voltage to the load. This allows C_out to be small enough (e.g., 0.8-1.0 uF) to satisfy the tup < 0.15s requirement while keeping vpp < 20mV.
